title: yokoso config
description: /etc/yokoso/config.json: every key is optional, and a theme's keys go on top of the theme's.

user.description: The account to start with, listed or not.

userList.description: List the accounts to pick from; false asks for a name every time.

session.description: The session to start with: a desktop file's name or one of sessions.

remember.description: Start with the last login's user and that user's last session.

reveal.description: An eye in the field that shows the password as it's typed.

keyboard.description: An on-screen keyboard, for a screen without a keyboard of its own.

power.description: The power buttons, in order, those logind allows.

oneOf.description: A reboot into a boot loader entry (bootctl list shows the ids).

sessions.description: Sessions of your own, first in the list.

env.description: Variables for every session; a session's own env wins.

theme.description: "dark", "light", "high-contrast", a theme's name or a theme file's path.

output.description: The screen with the form ("DP-1"), or "cursor" for the one the pointer is on.

scale.description: The UI scale; 0 takes it from the screen's size.

idle.description: Seconds without input before the screen goes dark; 0 for never.

language.description: The language of yokoso's own words ("en", "ru"); "" for the locale's.

x11Wrapper.description: What starts an X server for an X11 session, with its command after it.
